qwen.sentence: On 16,384 WikiArt paintings outside ArtELingo (MMArt; exact and near copies of ArtELingo train and validation paintings removed), c*'s recipe with the Qwen3-VL-Embedding-2B image as its only input at test (frozen; never trained or picked on these paintings) clusters and retrieves paintings by emotion (MMArt's labels), style and genre better than the plain Qwen3-VL-Embedding-2B image, and clusters them better than PercepT on the Qwen3-VL-Embedding-2B image (AMI with 20 clusters; mAP with read-outs picked on validation paintings with MMArt labels; 5 seeds). Qwen3-VL-Embedding-2B is one of four encoders; the three besides Qwen passed an earlier held emotion test on ArtELingo.
